title: yencoding-multi: is_complete() allocates a Vec just to check is_empty()
description: is_complete() calls missing_ranges() which allocates a Vec<Range<u64>> then immediately checks .is_empty(). In a tight reassembly loop (polling after each add_part), this allocates and deallocates on every call — O(n) allocations for n parts. Inline a direct cursor-walk that returns bool without allocating.
